liveUiInspection.method: Isolated profile with existing production behavior, built file renderer and DOM actions. Real startup registration is disabled by the test profile; physical input is supported by the prior user-performed manual QA.

verificationToolIssue.finding: The audit attempted an unavailable Tray tooltip getter after the UI flows passed.
verificationToolIssue.fix: Audit-only correction: verify configured tooltip copy in source, and native application/tray menu/window branding at runtime.

onboardingDemoControls.replay: Profile chip -> Replay welcome tour: dashboard tour only; completion/profile/hydration/history preserved.
onboardingDemoControls.reset: Profile chip -> Reset onboarding -> confirm: only completion becomes false; name/createdAt/water/history/streak/settings preserved.
onboardingDemoControls.immediateWelcome: After reset use Continue setup, or close/reopen the dashboard from tray.
onboardingDemoControls.completion: Start my day persists completion; retain routine values to avoid a settings change.
onboardingDemoControls.verification: Focused native onboarding regression includes exact hydration file preservation during replay/reset and profile/settings restoration.

branding.legitimateInputHints: Your name is a normal input hint, not placeholder/demo status copy.

Reopened dashboard holds on preserved name/progress/branding

preconditions: Production tray label has no Dev suffix and no development controls.
Enabled/unpaused reminders and at least two configured glasses remaining below goal.
No active companion or pending return; Pause then Resume clears a previous pending return.
Actual display name, prefilled routine, approved current artwork.
Visible SlingSip tray icon, clean primary desktop, notifications quiet, recorder captures display.
Set motion preferences for the intended full-animation shot; preserve accessibility support.
recording.dataPreservation: No hydration reset, fake history, registry migration or system-clock change. Rehearsal drink actions record real water.

manuallyHideOrPrepare: Profile popover except during profile shot
SlingSip tray icon visible; avoid OS startup registry view with legacy identifier
knownLimitations: Automated native pointer test remains a documented flaky harness limitation; manual physical click-through passed.
Production Later uses configured retry, five minutes by default; show scheduling without waiting.
Bottle display is short: keep it continuously visible at normal speed.
Current character is approved 2.5D PNG artwork with source resolution/crop limits; avoid extreme zoom/historical 3D assets.
Primary work area only; secure desktop/exclusive fullscreen/physical multi-monitor DPI changes are outside the planned take.
Windows software rendering can increase visible CPU.
